verdict.rationale: Increase exposes a comprehensive REST/OpenAPI surface (confirmed via openapi.json) covering accounts, account numbers, transfers (ACH/wire/RTP/check), holds, webhooks and event polling — enough for an agent to programmatically read most of the banking picture without dashboard scraping. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated MCP server, and document/statement retrieval and detailed transaction-history endpoints for agent consumption aren't explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit MCP surface/endpoint, documented transaction-history/statement/document retrieval API, independent confirmation of agent usage against these read endpoints.
